description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the dedicated join permission. Valid values:
- **true**: Enable the dedicated join permission.
- **false**: Disable the dedicated join permission.

description.zh: 要操作的专用入网凭证ID。
description.en: The ID of the dedicated join permission to operate on.

title.zh: 启用或停用专用入网凭证
title.en: Enable or disable a dedicated join permission
